verification.cargo_fetch_step: Deterministic and sufficient. `cargo fetch --locked` without --target downloads dependencies for all targets, so the platform-only crates that `cargo tree --locked --offline --target all` needs are fetched. It fills the registry index cache and the crate sources. --locked makes Cargo.lock drift fail, and the step has a 10-minute timeout and no retry. The cache key is Cargo.lock-hashed with a prefix restore-key. A cold runner, an exact hit and a partial restore all end with the same fetched set, because fetch fills whatever is missing before the tests run. The cache only changes how long the step takes, not whether the offline tree test passes. The step runs in both the test job (all three OSes) and the coverage job, which are the two jobs that run `cargo test --workspace` or llvm-cov, so no workspace-test job is left without it.
